title: Print a greeting
summary: PowerShell: Print a greeting. Change the name.
introduction: Write-Output sends a value to the output stream. Here it appears in the terminal.

blocks.text: Open PowerShell 7. Paste one example or save it as lesson.ps1 and run pwsh -NoProfile -File lesson.ps1. No administrator access is needed.
Write-Output sends one string to the output stream. The host displays it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Write-Output sends data; Write-Host is mainly for host display.
